facts.none: No confirmed questions yet (ask in the chat and press Confirm)

empty.none: Write a question or put in data, and the chart grows here
empty.dataOnly: {{n}} kinds have no term yet. Write what you want to know and they get a name.
empty.questionsOnly: No data answers yet. Put your data here and Asterism looks for matching kinds.

decide.noTerms: No terms yet. You can make one in “Questions”.

about.termNoStarHint: Put data that fits this term here and a kind appears.
about.hubHint: Records from separate datasets are linked by shared values.
about.discardAsk: This discards the draft. It cannot be undone.

chat.example: For example: "Is this kind the same as Specimen?"
chat.bindHint: AI proposes links for published kinds that no term has been linked to yet ({{n}}). It only proposes: nothing is written until you press “Add to the map”.
chat.writePlaceholder: What you want to know, in one line (e.g. What can lower thermal conductivity?)
chat.consultPlaceholder: Say it in a line (e.g. I think scattering factors tie to lattice thermal conductivity)
chat.starPlaceholder: A line about this star (e.g. Is this kind the same as Specimen?)

suggest.title: Links that could be made
suggest.lead: Names in the data you published match term names exactly (counted by a machine, no AI). You decide. They are drawn on the map as proposed lines.

add.closeHint: Where you are is kept. Press "Add data" again to continue.

now.star: Now: star "{{name}}" — ask about this star

suggestQ.askTerm: Suggest what to ask about this term
suggestQ.title: How about these questions?
suggestQ.nonePaper: No question found in this paper's abstract and conclusion
suggestQ.noneTerm: No question found from this term and its relations
